random_seed_roots.fallback: unset oscillator/noise/frontend/path roots inherit the resolved channel seed
random_seed_roots.channel_root_scope: static timing/CFO/clock/drift truth, spread ray, and frequency-selective perturbation
random_seed_roots.oscillator_root_scope: TX/RX oscillator spectra and FHSS phase resets
random_seed_roots.frontend_root_scope: DAC/ADC conversion, impulse process, and tone phase
random_seed_roots.path_root_scope: independent stationary OU or Gaussian-FIR ray gains and initial diurnal path phase

channel_model.selective_modulation_rate_source: effective spread Doppler; slow component runs at one tenth
channel_model.selective_frequency_frame: fixed public channel frame; hidden oscillator truth is never used to recenter
channel_model.selective_law_note: dispersive-dft-v1 with auto scale is a spacing-scaled stress law; it does not represent the separately configured ray delay or Doppler
channel_model.sample_clock_reference: RX0ppm; TX carries declared relative error

spread_inputs.semantics: selected preset supplies nominal dimensions; explicit physical overrides replace their own nominal dimension before one margin multiplication; without preset, legacy channel values supply the base, and remain already effective when no override is supplied; receiver tap basis is independent

path_evolution.gaussian_target_correlation: exp(-0.5*(pi*B*tau)^2); B=2*sigma of each ray Gaussian Doppler PSD; existing ray-center separation is independent
path_evolution.gaussian_teacher: stationary proper-complex white Gaussian innovations convolved with a discrete L2-normalized Gaussian FIR; finite truncation and sampling approximate the target covariance; actual FIR shape is reported separately
path_evolution.ray_model: fixed unit ray gains; existing equal-power two-ray delay and Doppler retained when selected
path_evolution.outage_model: signal-only attenuation on [start,end), with cosine descent/ascent inside the interval; thermal noise and path/filter state continue
path_evolution.scope: declared physical-path stress, not field calibration; OU is point sampled and has an unbounded analog spectrum; the Gaussian FIR target also has unbounded spectral tails and its six-sigma-per-edge capture allowance is not strict support, so finite deterministic capture bounds are not a bandwidth guarantee and sampling-rate refinement is required

source_hash_note: source and binary hashes must be bound externally to this uncommitted study build

sampled_frontend.impulse_process: one-sample occupancy probability 1-exp(-rate/Fs_RX); at most one event per sample; independent uniform phase
sampled_frontend.ordering: shaped source; DAC gain, ENOB error, TPDF and quantization; TX oscillator and gain; shared propagation; RX oscillator; thermal noise; receiver-coordinate interference; one-pole analog filter; legacy slow AGC; gain step and overload recovery; ADC gain, ENOB error, TPDF and quantization; observed erasure mask
sampled_frontend.converter_error_model: synthetic independent Gaussian input error, variance=(step_ENOB^2-step_nominal^2)/12; not calibrated hardware ENOB or distortion
sampled_frontend.tone_coordinate: receiver tuned baseband; not fixed RF; occupancy uses receiver nominal t=0 400-ms dwells
sampled_frontend.dac_dither_guards: converter noise can occupy shaped guards while finite transmitter source exists; absent transmitter disables DAC
sampled_frontend.noise_normalization: reported variance is pre-frontend thermal input variance; transformed samples may be colored and non-Gaussian
sampled_frontend.signal_energy_report_stage: after shared propagation and RX oscillator; before thermal noise and sampled frontend

endpoint_truth.scope: simulation evaluation only; endpoint realizations are never receiver search inputs

gaussian_ray_teacher.covariance_formula: R[m]=sum(k=0..L-1-m,h[k]*h[k+m]) for 0<=m<L, otherwise 0; lag_seconds=m*sample_interval_seconds; proper-complex variance R[0]=1 when active
gaussian_ray_teacher.scope: actual finite sampled teacher covariance; empty coefficients and zero sample interval when disabled; evaluation/oracle diagnostics only, distinct from ideal Gaussian target

path_truth_simulation_only.scope: seeded physical truth; never a practical receiver search input

observation_endpoint_report.scope: natural endpoint includes all source/interpolation/ray/selective/frontend tails; public fixed calendar may append zero-input observation rows
